name: Alton Towers Hotel
description: The flagship 4-star hotel at Alton Towers resort, elaborately themed around the history and legends of the estate. Spectacular themed rooms with direct park access and early entry included.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Themed room for up to 4 guests with estate decor and all modern amenities.

rooms.name: CBeebies Land Room
rooms.description: Immersively themed room for young families featuring beloved CBeebies characters.

name: Enchanted Village
description: A magical woodland resort featuring beautifully themed lodges and treehouses nestled among the trees. Each lodge includes a hot tub and is individually themed.

rooms.name: Themed Lodge
rooms.description: Beautifully decorated lodge sleeping up to 4 guests with private hot tub.

rooms.name: Treehouse
rooms.description: Unique treehouse accommodation sleeping up to 5 guests among the woodland canopy.

name: Splash Landings Hotel
description: A 3-star Caribbean-themed hotel featuring the spectacular indoor Cariba Creek waterpark. Bright tropical rooms with direct resort access, ideal for families.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Fun tropical-themed room for up to 4 guests with waterpark access included.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Larger room with extra beds sleeping up to 5 guests comfortably.
